Fruity Red Wine Sangria
By: Julia
Published: Tuesday, August 23, 2016 - 7:26am

Ingredients




1 Bottle of Red Wine
250ml (1 cup) Orange Juice (preferably freshly squeezed from 3 medium oranges)
2 Nectarines, sliced
1 Apple
½ Orange
2-3 Tablespoons Brown Sugar
125ml (1/2 cup) Water
Ice

Preparation

1 Melt sugar in ½ cup of hot water (I normally use kettle to boil the water so it dissolves faster). Let it cool down. 2 Meanwhile pour wine in a large pitcher/glass bowl. Throw in sliced nectarines, apple and sliced orange. Add orange juice and cold sugar syrup. Stir well. 3 Cover with cling film and place in the fridge for several hours (at least 2), preferably overnight. 4 Serve with ice cubes!

About

If you are planning a party, then this homemade fruity red wine sangria is a “must have” on your table! Refreshing, with citrusy flavor and a hint of summer fruits!
